meta.title: MOSS multimodal
meta.description: Open MOSS workbench from the sidebar and save an API key in its settings. Includes images, single/multi-speaker speech, voice cloning/design, transcription, image/video understanding, and uploads. Inputs are sent to the configured MOSS API; keys stay in DSH credentials. Uses URL results and audio task polling; realtime video and PCM/SSE playback are not included.
